propositions: External complexity (lizard) and duplication (jscpd) analyzer adapters are built but not consumed by registered code_health metrics, leaving them as dead code.
The metrics evaluation system must invoke each configured signal producer at most once per metrics context and cache both successful and Unavailable outcomes to avoid redundant tool invocations.
Missing or unavailable producers (lizard, scc, jscpd) must yield honest Unavailable reasons naming the missing producer rather than zeros or generic error strings.

The metrics command and E2E output must expose loc, complexity, and duplication values for Python and Go fixtures when tools are present, and render clear Unavailable entries when producers are absent.
Core-only imports must remain dependency-free with no hard dependency on external tools and no import-time tool loading outside the metrics extra.
